page.title: Working calendars
page.branchHint: Select the branch whose working calendar you want to view or publish.
page.yearHint: Select last year, this year, or one of the next two years.
page.workingDaysCountHint: Total working days configured across the selected year.
page.holidaysCountHint: Total non-working days including weekends and public holidays.
page.forbiddenText: You do not have permission to view working calendars.
page.loadFailedText: Something went wrong while loading the working calendar. Try again.
page.discardText: You have unpublished changes to this working calendar. Switching now will discard them.
page.branchPermission: Ask your administrator for the View branches permission to choose a branch.

week.workingDaysHint: Days of the week marked as regular working days (Sunday first).
week.workingHoursHint: Daily 24-hour start and end times applied across regular working days.
week.timeZoneHint: IANA region time zone, such as Africa/Cairo, used to interpret working hours and SLA deadlines. It stays the same for every calendar of the branch.

yearGrid.sectionHint: Choose individual working days for the selected year. Publish to apply your changes.

windows.empty: No custom time windows configured for this year.
windows.layerHint: Priority layer number from 1 to 9. Windows in the same layer cannot overlap.
windows.fromHint: First date of the calendar year when this window applies.
windows.toHint: Last date of the calendar year when this window applies.
windows.startHint: 24-hour start time for working days inside this window.
windows.endHint: 24-hour end time for working days inside this window.
windows.daysHint: Weekdays within the date range covered by this window.
windows.label: Label
windows.labelHint: Optional short description such as Ramadan hours or summer shift.
windows.deleteText: Remove this time window from the draft calendar? Publish to apply the change.
windows.sectionHint: Dated working-hour overrides for this year. Windows in the same layer cannot overlap.

validation.hoursOrder: Start time must be earlier than end time.
validation.layerInvalid: Enter a whole layer number from 1 to {{max}}.
validation.dateOrder: End date must be on or after the start date.
validation.dateYearMismatch: Date must fall within the selected calendar year ({{year}}).
validation.windowOverlap: This window overlaps another window in the same layer on a shared weekday and time.
validation.windowsMax: A calendar can hold at most {{max}} windows.

errors.CRM_WORKING_CALENDAR_REVISION_CONFLICT: The calendar changed. Reload or keep your changes.
errors.CRM_WORKING_CALENDAR_INVALID: Check the working days and time windows for this year.
errors.CRM_CALENDAR_HOURS_INVALID: Check the start and end times of the working hours and windows.
errors.CRM_CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE_INVALID: Select a valid region time zone. Use the same zone for every calendar of this branch.
errors.CRM_CALENDAR_WINDOW_OVERLAP: Time windows in the same layer overlap. Check their dates, weekdays and hours.
errors.BRANCH_PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to access this branch calendar.
